For best results, be clear about where you want players to chat with you, whether it be on Reddit, Discord, Your Steam Forums, some other forums, or any other location of your choosing. Provide a link within the event description so players know where to find you. You may also want to seed your chat with some comments of your own to invite players in to join.

You’ll also be able to disable and re-enable your own demo whenever you wish.
